request.spec:
A third role, viewer, can be assigned. A viewer sees every screen and figure and can change nothing:
every form submission and every action, including changing the sheet's today, a statement, a hold
and the paste box, is refused with its usual error, writes nothing and changes nothing. A bulk
button (open, settle, reassign, grade, retire, hold, re-date, void) or a generate button (periods, a
fiscal year, quarters, plans) pressed by a viewer goes through with nothing done: its counts show 0
done and every selected item refused, and no error shows; a paste, an import, a rollover and every
other form or action by a viewer is refused with its error.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A third role, viewer, can be assigned. A viewer sees every screen and figure and can change nothing:
every form submission and every action, including changing the sheet's today, a statement, a hold
and the paste box, is refused with its usual error, writes nothing and changes nothing. A bulk
button (open, settle, reassign, grade, retire, hold, re-date, void) or a generate button (periods, a
fiscal year, quarters, plans) pressed by a viewer goes through with nothing done: its counts show 0
done and every selected item refused, and no error shows; a paste, an import, a rollover and every
other form or action by a viewer is refused with its error.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
A third role, `viewer`, can now be assigned. A viewer sees the whole sheet but can't change anything. All 4 acceptance tests pass with `bin/e2e`.

- **Role:** `viewer` was added next to clerk and steward on the server, in the role form's checks and in its suggestion list. Any other role name, such as "boss", is still refused.
- **Refusals:** a new server check runs before each request. When a viewer sends anything that would change a sheet, it is refused before anything is written, so nothing reaches the store or the audit file and the form shows its usual error. This covers changing the sheet's today, statements, holds, paste, quick-add, rates, settings, people and claim actions. Loading a sheet is still allowed.
- **Bulk buttons:** bulk open and bulk settle let a viewer's press go through with nothing done. The counts show 0 done and every selected claim refused, with no error.
- **Permission rules:** a viewer never passes the per-action permission check, whatever roles the sheet's permission settings list. Those settings still only accept clerk and steward.

This app only has bulk open and bulk settle. The other bulk and generate buttons the request lists (reassign, grade, retire, hold, re-date, void, and generating periods, a fiscal year, quarters or plans) don't exist here, so I had nothing to change for them. If any are added later, their request handlers need the same exemption marker as bulk open and settle, and their service should count everything as refused for a viewer. Otherwise the new check will refuse them with an error.

No database migration was needed, because the role column already stores the role as text. The new check is in `setting/ViewerGuard.java`, with the exemption marker `OpenToViewer.java` and the refusal error `ViewerRefusedException.java` beside it. The bulk counts are in `claim/ClaimBulkService.java`.
